main_text.p: cundum juris Præceptum;l.10.D. de Just. & jur.§. 2.Instit. codem. alterum non lædes. Quod enim in thesi ita obtiner, id in hypothesi aliter sese habet; & aliquid indefinite illicitum judicatur quod tamen in circumstantiis censebitur esse licitum. Non itaque alterum lædes nisi cum te aliter tueri non potes, neque occides, nisi licite, id est, adhibito moderamine incul-patæ tutelæ. Neque 3. obstat dictum Valentiniani, Imperatoris, Homicida, quod fecit exspe-ctet. Respondeo enim dictum illud accipi oportere, de homi-cidâ dolosòl.3.D. de Just.& jur.l.3.in medio. Cod. de Epis. Aud. quique extra causam justæ defensionis humanum sanguinem effundit. Ut secus dicendum sit, si quisquam urgente necessitate adversario necem intentaverit.
Concordant etiam juri ci-c.interfecisti. de Homic. Volunt. vili canones, qui licitam statuunt sui defensionem, modoc. non æ-stumem[?]. ea cum moderamine sit con-13 q.2. jun-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "dolosò" (the word is printed with a long-s-like letter, read as dolosò [?] in the text); "c. non æ-stumem" in the right margin is hard to read, given as æstumem[?]. The text ends mid-word "con-jun-", continued on the next page. Marginal note "Neque 3." reads as printed. No catchword or signature is visible. The page has no heading.
